3576: Remote mining only works on uninhabited worlds. A ship fitted with mining robots, in orbit with the “Remote mining” task, extracts minerals every year according to the planet's concentration and drops them on its surface; a shuttle (a freighter making round trips) comes to collect them for the capital or the chosen port. In “Worlds being mined”, “+ Miner” adds a mining ship and “+ Shuttle” a freighter, ready or to be built. Concentrations slowly drop with use. A world habitable for your race is often worth more as a colony.
